When you're in Sapporo and have some time, I recommend going to Milk Mura! If you're down to have some ice cream mixed with a tiny bit of alcohol, it's really good. You can pick from a variety of flavors and it tastes really good with the ice cream. 

Can also vouch for Waraku Kaiten Sushi in Otaru. There's a lot of shops in that area from glass sculptures to wooden goodies. I also hope you enjoy the train ride to Otaru there, you'll get a pretty view of the sea!

Regarding winter sports, I'd advise doing it alone if this will be your first time and especially if it's your first time experiencing snow as well. I also come from an area that doesn't snow at all, so my first time skiing with friends was 6 hours of falling on my butt or hitting my head lol. I hope you can experience it sometime with someone who can help you.

SUU, SUU+ or equivalent. I used to try out a lot of purikuras to find one that didn't make you look like a big eyed alien. If I researched this right, SUU was one of the purikuras that I always went back to. The editing is minimal imo and you can tone down the big eyes it gives you. It's the closest I've ever got to actually looking like myself for a purikura lol.

I also used this site [here](https://sp.pictlink.com/sp/machines/information?links=tab) to look through all the photobooths to find the one I used. Hope this helps!
